title: Source-matched high-precision packed-real full product
objective: Add and validate the pinned PARI 2.17.4 x86-64 3520-bit full-integer product branch for packed-real multiplication at 153088 bits without changing the readable dynamic fallback or small-product branch

oracles: Pristine PARI 2.17.4 exact packed mantissa/precision/exponent fixtures

handoff.summary: Translated the pinned host's mulrrz_int branch into ordinary Python integer multiplication plus exact PARI normalization and rounding. Eight below/at/above-cutoff and 153088-bit fixtures agree exactly across pristine PARI, CPython, JavaScript, GMP, and tagged lowering; malformed batches are fail-atomic. Generated C contains mpz_mul, and a diagnostic size sweep grows 4.43x for a 42.71x operand-size increase rather than the 1824.51x quadratic size ratio.
risks: MULRR_MULII_LIMIT is host tuned. The translated 3520-bit cutoff matches the pinned Olinux-x86_64 reference, not every PARI build.
The scaling probe is diagnostic and unqualified against PARI; it establishes branch shape, not an end-to-end performance ratio.
The broad pnpm test:native lane gate was deliberately deferred under the no-broad-build/probe constraint; focused compiled differential checks and test:baselib:strict pass.
next_steps: Cherry-pick this lane into the end-to-end integration worktree and rerun the bounded 153088-bit real/complex corridor.
Run the broad native suite at the next coordinated integration checkpoint rather than competing with active heavy campaign builds.
